messages:
Noah: Heads-up — there’s a box of blueberry muffins in the kitchen, help yourself after 3pm. Also throwing an idea out there: can we start a simple ‘snack sourcing pledge’ so we don’t rely on mystery donations every week? @Priya @Zoe
Priya: Love that. Can we add an allergy/diet column? I’ll sign up for coffee beans instead of snacks most months. :)
Zoe: I can do decaf next week. Also someone left an unopened kombucha (no name) in the fridge — should we adopt a labeling rule?
Jules: +1 to labeling. Also we should maybe set a fridge-clearing day once a month so nothing goes rancid.
kitchen-bot: Reminder: Dishwasher cycle completed at 16:12. Please empty racks if you loaded them. :sparkles:
Noah: Cool. I sketched a 1-minute pledge sheet — nothing fancy. Quick poll: how often should people pledge to bring something? Reply with numbers.
Noah: Options: 1) once a month 2) once every two months 3) opt-in ad-hoc
Priya: 1) once a month :thumbsup:
Zoe: 2) every two months — lower burden :ok_hand:
Jules: 3) opt-in ad-hoc — flexible ftw :sunglasses:
Noah: OK mixed votes. Maybe do 1/month as the baseline but allow opt-out. I posted the pledge doc: https://docs.example.com/snack-pledge (private to team)
Noah: Quick copy of the sheet so you see columns:
```
Name,Month,Snack type (non-perishable if possible),Allergies/Diets,Notes
Noah,Mar,granola bars,none,gluten-free options available
Priya,Mar,coffee beans,n/a,2lb bag to share
Zoe,Apr,decaf tea,none,loose-leaf + infuser
```
Zoe: Can we add a separate coffee rotation note — I’ll handle grinder cleaning once a month if someone else does beans.
Jules: I’ll volunteer for the fridge-clearing day. Maybe last Friday of the month?
Noah: Sweet. I’ll put the pledge and a recurring calendar for fridge sweep. Also labeling stickers by the sink tomorrow.
kitchen-bot: New calendar event created: "Monthly Fridge Sweep" — last Friday every month at 4:30pm.
Noah: Thanks all — muffins are gone. Mission accomplished. :tada:
